subject.title: [Feature]: Slim the Skill Workshop system-prompt section; move mechanics into the tool schema

question: Should OpenClaw accept the proposed Skill Workshop prompt/schema split and softer wording while preserving the mandatory proposal-routing rule?
rationale: This changes model-facing safety and product tone, and the issue is protected by the `maintainer` label, so automation should not choose the exact wording unilaterally.

options.title: Approve slim prompt split
options.body: Proceed with a narrow cleanup that keeps the routing rule, moves mechanics into schema descriptions, and proves reduced combined prompt text.

options.title: Keep current guardrails
options.body: Leave the verbose prompt in place if maintainers prefer redundant model-facing prohibitions over lower token cost and softer tone.

options.title: Request wording draft first
options.body: Ask for exact proposed prompt and schema text before implementation if maintainers want to review tone separately from code.

recommendation.title: Approve slim prompt split
recommendation.body: Proceed with a narrow cleanup that keeps the routing rule, moves mechanics into schema descriptions, and proves reduced combined prompt text.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter opened the protected request and has the clearest current product-direction signal for this prompt wording decision.
